title: Soldoku
headline: From solo puzzle to competition.
body:
Mobile-first competitive Sudoku on Solana.
One shared grid. Your fastest valid finish.
Available on the web and Seeker.

title: A familiar puzzle. A shared challenge.
headline: Give every finish a rival
body:
Sudoku starts with a simple challenge: solve the grid. Soldoku adds a shared puzzle, a timed attempt, and a leaderboard that turns each finish into a competition.

Our goal: keep the puzzle familiar and make the competition rewarding.
note: Recurring rooms and shared results are our retention hypothesis; retention is not yet measured.

title: Choose your challenge
headline: Start without a wallet
body:
CLASSIC
Solo puzzles, notes, hints, pause and resume.

PRACTICE
Create a free race and share its room code.

COMPETE
Authorize a wallet message, start an attempt, and rank.
note: Free competition messages do not transfer tokens.

title: An entry players can inspect
headline: The stake goes into escrow
body:
Choose a preset or custom amount.

Confirmed entrants solve the same grid when registration closes.

The unique fastest valid finish claims the pool. Ties or no finishes refund entrants.
note: The server verifies gameplay and authorizes settlement; Solana holds the deposits.

title: Built and tested on Seeker
headline: The wallet stays in Seed Vault
body:
The Android shell loads Soldoku and hands wallet requests to Mobile Wallet Adapter.

Connection, message authorization, transaction approval, background return, cancellation and recovery were exercised on a physical device.
note: The app does not hold the player's private key.

title: A completed financial loop
headline: Deposits, payout and refunds
body:
Physical winner test: two 1-token deposits; 2-token prize claimed; vault empty.

Scheduled cron retained finalized settlement receipts.

DAABEC94: refund returned 1 token; wallet 20 to 21; vault empty.
note: Funded tests and the 11 October refund are documented in the public repository.

title: A usable demo with clear boundaries
headline: Play today. Broader funding comes later.
body:
Classic, Practice and free competitions are available.

New funded entry is paused; existing claims and refunds remain available.

Before wider financial operation: security triage, database restore rehearsal, and stronger fair-play controls. Card execution is disabled.
note: Devnet beta · Soldoku tokens have no cash value. Mainnet is not enabled.
